tickets.title: Structured failure fingerprints + base-vs-candidate differential classifier
acceptance: Gate output parsed to {suite, test, file, line, errorClass} rows with volatile values (timestamps, ports, tmp paths, durations) normalized before comparison

Deterministic classifier: base green + candidate red = regression (consumes attempt); identical red fingerprints = blocked_on_baseline (consumes none, candidate preserved); mixed = only NEW failures charged; base red + candidate green = flagged for explicit review, never silently absorbed
Model prose can never override the classification — the classifier is pure code with table-driven tests covering all four rows

Wired: baseline cache stores rows + CURRENT.json pointer (scope WIDENED to baseline.mjs — unowned, needed for the base half); gates.mjs computes+logs the differential on receipt failure; ticket.mjs breaks the ladder on blocked_on_baseline (zero charge, branch preserved) and on mixed sends the coder ONLY the NEW rows. 11 new tests incl. the volatile-noise twin-match hazard. Full gate 4832 green (first run failed eslint no-control-regex — fixed via charCode-built ANSI_RE, re-gated).

tickets.title: Product goal loop — user stories drive to a PROVEN product, not a drained board
acceptance: A goal loop (the /goal skill semantics, executable): INVENTORY = requirement ids RE-DERIVED from the SRS/USER_STORIES source text (never the ticket list); VERIFY = the P3-05 assemblyGate (requirement closure + assembly tickets + seam assertions + long-tail) PLUS a real verify receipt on main; EXIT = assemblyGate.pass — the product is DONE when every story is proven by an existing test and every seam resolves, not when tickets drain

GAP step: an `uncovered` requirement proposes a story-implementation ticket; a `coded-not-done` requirement proposes a proof ticket (E2E naming the requirement id); missing assembly/long-tail tickets are generated from the P3-05 generators — proposals are appended to the board tagged proposed_by=product-loop and remain subject to riskHoldReason and every conductor gate

DRIVE step: runs the conductor as a child process with a bounded --max-tickets per iteration (injected in tests); budgets per the goal-skill contract: iteration cap (default 5) and a NO-PROGRESS HALT when the gap fingerprint set is byte-identical to the previous iteration (the run-coverage-loop exit-3 rule) — escalation report names the stuck requirements
The loop writes docs/work/requirement-ledger.json each iteration (self-documenting progress: per-requirement status uncovered/coded-not-done/done + iteration history)

Pure core with injected ports (readSources, board IO, runConductor, mintVerifyReceipt, seamResults, testExists) — table-driven tests: exit-on-pass, gap-to-proposal per class, no-progress halt, iteration cap, proposals honor the risk tier; CLI wrapper scripts/product-loop.mjs wires real implementations
pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test green
tickets.notes: Landed 2026-08-31. THE PRODUCT GOAL LOOP: scripts/conductor/product-loop.mjs (pure core, injected ports) + scripts/product-loop.mjs CLI (--status = measure-only). INVENTORY re-derived from SRS/USER_STORIES text every iteration; VERIFY = assemblyGate + green receipt on main (receipts outrank bookkeeping — tested); EXIT = both, 'done meaning done'; GAP -> PRD-/PRF- proposals + assembly + long-tail rows, tagged proposed_by=product-loop, dedup'd, subject to every conductor gate; BUDGET = iteration cap 5 + byte-identical-gap no-progress halt (a class shift uncovered->coded-not-done IS progress and correctly does not halt — tested both ways). Goal artifact = docs/work/requirement-ledger.json carrying {success, non_goals, acceptance, sourcesSha} + per-iteration history — the Cherny doctrine: done is a PREDICATE, the goal has NON-GOALS, and it survives compaction in a FILE. Vendor research (Cursor/Anthropic/OpenAI) confirmed the three universal mechanisms and all three are this module's skeleton (header cites them). WIRED THE PROMISED CALLERS: all four P3-05 @unreached markers deleted, zero-marker fixture assertion restored, ratchet unchanged at 46/45 with ZERO suppressions. 10 tests (9 unit w/ stub assembler + 1 real-assembler integration proving the long-tail wave is proposed and blocks DONE).
